lldb.launch.initCommands: script import os; os.environ['PATH'] = os.environ.get('PATH', '') + os.pathsep + os.path.join(os.path.expanduser('~'), '.cargo', 'bin')
lldb.launch.preRunCommands: script import os; lldb.debugger.HandleCommand('process handle SIGCHLD -s false -n false -p true') if os.name != 'nt' else None
